int[][] insert_sorted(int[][] points, int[] point)
    place := int(#points)
    for: i < int(#points)
        if point[0] < points[i][0]
            place = i
            break
    return points[0:<place].append(point).concat(points[place:<int(#points)])

class Cell(int column, int row, int[] box, int[][] points)

class Grid(int world, int cell_size, int side, Cell[] cells)
    int[] position(int[] point)
        return [point[1] / cell_size, point[2] / cell_size]

    int cell_index(int[] point)
        cell := position(point)
        return cell[1] * side + cell[0]

    void .insert(int[] point)
        index := cell_index(point)
        cells[index].points = insert_sorted(cells[index].points, point)

    void .delete(int[] point)
        index := cell_index(point)
        cells[index].points = [for value := cells[index].points[] if value[0] != point[0] then value]

Grid build(int[][] points, int world, int cell_size)
    side := world / cell_size
    Cell[] cells := []
    for: row < side
        for: column < side
            x := column * cell_size
            y := row * cell_size
            cells = cells.append(Cell(column, row, [x, y, x + cell_size - 1, y + cell_size - 1], []))
    result := Grid(world, cell_size, side, cells)
    for point := points[]
        .result.insert(point)
    return result

bool less(int[] first, int[] second, int axis)
    a := first[axis + 1]
    b := second[axis + 1]
    if a != b
        return a < b
    a = first[2 - axis]
    b = second[2 - axis]
    return if a != b then a < b else first[0] < second[0]

int[][] sorted_points(int[][] points, int axis)
    int[][] result := []
    for point := points[]
        place := int(#result)
        for: i < int(#result)
            if less(point, result[i], axis)
                place = i
                break
        result = result[0:<place].append(point).concat(result[place:<int(#result)])
    return result

class Node(int[] point, int axis, int left, int right)

class Tree self(Node[] nodes, int root)
    int .build_subtree(int[][] points, int depth)
        if #points == 0
            return -1
        axis := depth % 2
        ordered := sorted_points(points, axis)
        middle := int(#ordered) / 2
        index := int(#nodes)
        nodes = nodes.append(Node(ordered[middle], axis, -1, -1))
        left := .self.build_subtree(ordered[0:<middle], depth + 1)
        right := .self.build_subtree(ordered[middle + 1:<int(#ordered)], depth + 1)
        nodes[index].left = left
        nodes[index].right = right
        return index

    void .insert(int[] point)
        if root < 0
            root = int(#nodes)
            nodes = nodes.append(Node(point, 0, -1, -1))
            return
        current := root
        while true
            axis := nodes[current].axis
            left := less(point, nodes[current].point, axis)
            child := if left then nodes[current].left else nodes[current].right
            if child < 0
                index := int(#nodes)
                nodes = nodes.append(Node(point, 1 - axis, -1, -1))
                if left
                    nodes[current].left = index
                else
                    nodes[current].right = index
                return
            current = child

    int[] minimum_point(int start, int axis)
        pending := [start]
        int[] best := []
        while #pending != 0
            current := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
            value := nodes[current]
            if value.axis == axis and value.left >= 0
                pending = pending.append(value.left)
            else
                if #best == 0 or less(value.point, best, axis)
                    best = value.point
                if value.axis != axis
                    if value.right >= 0
                        pending = pending.append(value.right)
                    if value.left >= 0
                        pending = pending.append(value.left)
        return best

    void .delete(int[] point)
        current := root
        parent := -1
        left := false
        while current >= 0
            value := nodes[current]
            if value.point[0] != point[0]
                parent = current
                left = less(point, value.point, value.axis)
                current = if left then value.left else value.right
            elif value.right >= 0
                point = minimum_point(value.right, value.axis)
                nodes[current].point = point
                parent = current
                left = false
                current = value.right
            elif value.left >= 0
                point = minimum_point(value.left, value.axis)
                nodes[current].point = point
                nodes[current].right = value.left
                nodes[current].left = -1
                parent = current
                left = false
                current = value.left
            else
                if parent < 0
                    root = -1
                elif left
                    nodes[parent].left = -1
                else
                    nodes[parent].right = -1
                return

Tree build(int[][] points)
    result := Tree([], -1)
    result.root = .result.build_subtree(points, 0)
    return result

import dataset = "./dataset.qui"

import report = "./report.qui"

string[] structure_names()
    return ["kdtree", "quadtree", "rtree", "str", "grid", "rtree_rect", "str_rect"]

string[] command_names()
    return ["RANGE", "RADIUS", "KNN", "WINDOWCOUNT", "CONTAINS", "NEAREST", "JOIN"]

string words(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return fields.join(" ")

int index_name(string[] names, string name)
    for: i < int(#names)
        if names[i] == name
            return i
    return -1

int[] point_object(int[] point)
    return [point[0], point[1], point[2], point[1], point[2]]

int[][] point_objects(int[][] points)
    return [for point := points[] then point_object(point)]

int[] object_box(int[] object)
    return object[1:<5]

int[] raw_point(int[] object)
    return object[0:<3]

int minimum_distance(int[] query, int[] box)
    dx := if query[0] < box[0] then box[0] - query[0] elif query[0] > box[2] then query[0] - box[2] else 0
    dy := if query[1] < box[1] then box[1] - query[1] elif query[1] > box[3] then query[1] - box[3] else 0
    return dx * dx + dy * dy

int[] | error object_for(const map<int, int[]> lookup, int id)
    match lookup.get(id)
        int[] value
            return value
        none
            return error("Missing indexed object")

int[][] ordered_distances(int[][] pairs)
    keys := [for pair := pairs[] then pair[1] * 100000 + pair[0]]
    return [for key := keys.sorted()[] then [key % 100000, key / 100000]]

int[][] ordered_join(int[][] pairs)
    keys := [for pair := pairs[] then pair[0] * 100000 + pair[1]]
    return [for key := keys.sorted()[] then [key / 100000, key % 100000]]

class ViewNode(int[] box, int[][] objects, int[] children, int count, int depth, string mark, int source, axis := 0, int[] square := [], level := 0, entry_count := 0)
class View(string name, ViewNode[] nodes)

void finish_counts(ViewNode[] &nodes)
    for: reverse < int(#nodes)
        index := int(#nodes) - reverse - 1
        count := int(#nodes[index].objects)
        for child := nodes[index].children[]
            count += nodes[child].count
        nodes[index].count = count

int[] preorder(View view)
    int[] result := []
    pending := [0]
    while #pending != 0
        index := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        result = result.append(index)
        children := view.nodes[index].children
        for child := children[::-1][]
            pending = pending.append(child)
    return result

View kd_view(kdtree.Tree tree, int world)
    nodes := [ViewNode([0, 0, world - 1, world - 1], [], [], 0, 0, "root", tree.root)]
    pending := [0]
    while #pending != 0
        index := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        kdtree.Node original := tree.nodes[nodes[index].source]
        nodes[index].objects = [point_object(original.point)]
        nodes[index].axis = original.axis
        split := original.point[original.axis + 1]
        if original.left >= 0
            box := nodes[index].box
            box[original.axis + 2] = split
            child := int(#nodes)
            nodes = nodes.append(ViewNode(box, [], [], 0, nodes[index].depth + 1, "L", original.left))
            nodes[index].children = nodes[index].children.append(child)
        if original.right >= 0
            box := nodes[index].box
            box[original.axis] = split
            child := int(#nodes)
            nodes = nodes.append(ViewNode(box, [], [], 0, nodes[index].depth + 1, "R", original.right))
            nodes[index].children = nodes[index].children.append(child)
        children := nodes[index].children
        pending = pending.concat(children[::-1])
    finish_counts(&nodes)
    return View("kdtree", nodes)

View quad_view(quadtree.Tree tree)
    quadtree.Node initial := tree.nodes[0]
    root_box := [initial.x, initial.y, initial.x + initial.size - 1, initial.y + initial.size - 1]
    nodes := [ViewNode(root_box, [], [], 0, 0, "root", 0)]
    marks := ["NW", "NE", "SW", "SE"]
    pending := [0]
    while #pending != 0
        index := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        quadtree.Node original := tree.nodes[nodes[index].source]
        nodes[index].square = [original.x, original.y, original.size]
        if #original.children == 0
            nodes[index].objects = point_objects(original.points)
        else
            for: i < 4
                source := original.children[i]
                quadtree.Node value := tree.nodes[source]
                box := [value.x, value.y, value.x + value.size - 1, value.y + value.size - 1]
                child := int(#nodes)
                nodes = nodes.append(ViewNode(box, [], [], 0, nodes[index].depth + 1, marks[i], source))
                nodes[index].children = nodes[index].children.append(child)
            children := nodes[index].children
            pending = pending.concat(children[::-1])
    finish_counts(&nodes)
    return View("quadtree", nodes)

View rtree_view(string name, rtree.Tree tree, const map<int, int[]> lookup)
    nodes := [ViewNode(tree.node_box(tree.root), [], [], 0, 0, "root", tree.root)]
    pending := [0]
    while #pending != 0
        index := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        rtree.Node original := tree.nodes[nodes[index].source]
        nodes[index].level = original.level
        nodes[index].entry_count = int(#original.entries)
        if original.level == 0
            for entry := original.entries[]
                object := object_for(lookup, entry.id)
                nodes[index].objects = nodes[index].objects.append(object)
        else
            for entry := original.entries[]
                child := int(#nodes)
                nodes = nodes.append(ViewNode(entry.box, [], [], 0, nodes[index].depth + 1, "", entry.child))
                nodes[index].children = nodes[index].children.append(child)
            children := nodes[index].children
            pending = pending.concat(children[::-1])
    finish_counts(&nodes)
    return View(name, nodes)

View grid_view(grid.Grid cells)
    box := [0, 0, cells.world - 1, cells.world - 1]
    nodes := [ViewNode(box, [], [], 0, 0, "root", -1)]
    for: i < int(#cells.cells)
        grid.Cell cell := cells.cells[i]
        child := int(#nodes)
        nodes = nodes.append(ViewNode(cell.box, point_objects(cell.points), [], 0, 1, "", i))
        nodes[0].children = nodes[0].children.append(child)
    finish_counts(&nodes)
    return View("grid", nodes)

bool object_condition(int command, int[] values, int[] object)
    box := object_box(object)
    if command == 1
        return minimum_distance(values, box) <= values[2] * values[2]
    if command == 4
        return rtree.contains(box, [values[0], values[1], values[0], values[1]])
    return rtree.contains(values, box)

bool region_condition(int command, int[] values, int[] box)
    if command == 1
        return minimum_distance(values, box) <= values[2] * values[2]
    if command == 4
        return rtree.contains(box, [values[0], values[1], values[0], values[1]])
    return rtree.intersects(box, values)

class Answer(int[] ids, int[][] pairs, int count)
class SearchResult(int[] ids, int[][] pairs, int count, int nodes, int tests)

SearchResult conditional_search(View view, int command, int[] values)
    pending := [0]
    int[] ids := []
    count := 0
    nodes := 0
    tests := 0
    while #pending != 0
        index := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        node := view.nodes[index]
        nodes += 1
        if command == 3 and rtree.contains(values, node.box)
            count += node.count
        else
            tests += int(#node.objects)
            for object := node.objects[]
                if object_condition(command, values, object)
                    ids = ids.append(object[0])
                    count += 1
            for child := node.children[::-1][]
                if region_condition(command, values, view.nodes[child].box)
                    pending = pending.append(child)
    return SearchResult(ids.sorted(), [], count, nodes, tests)

class HeapElement(int[] key, int node, int[] object)

void heap_push(HeapElement[] &heap, HeapElement item)
    heap = heap.append(item)
    index := int(#heap) - 1
    while index > 0
        parent := (index - 1) / 2
        if not rtree.less(item.key, heap[parent].key)
            break
        heap[index] = heap[parent]
        index = parent
    heap[index] = item

HeapElement heap_pop(HeapElement[] &heap)
    result := heap[0]
    last := heap[-1]
    heap = heap[0:<int(#heap) - 1]
    if #heap == 0
        return result
    index := 0
    while 2 * index + 1 < int(#heap)
        child := 2 * index + 1
        if child + 1 < int(#heap) and rtree.less(heap[child + 1].key, heap[child].key)
            child += 1
        if not rtree.less(heap[child].key, last.key)
            break
        heap[index] = heap[child]
        index = child
    heap[index] = last
    return result

SearchResult nearest_search(View view, int[] values)
    HeapElement[] heap := []
    int[][] answer := []
    serial := 1
    nodes := 0
    tests := 0
    heap_push(&heap, HeapElement([minimum_distance(values, view.nodes[0].box), 0, 0], 0, []))
    while #heap != 0
        item := heap_pop(&heap)
        if item.key[1] == 1
            answer = answer.append([item.object[0], item.key[0]])
            if int(#answer) == values[2]
                break
        else
            node := view.nodes[item.node]
            nodes += 1
            tests += int(#node.objects)
            for object := node.objects[]
                heap_push(&heap, HeapElement([minimum_distance(values, object_box(object)), 1, object[0]], -1, object))
            for child := node.children[]
                heap_push(&heap, HeapElement([minimum_distance(values, view.nodes[child].box), 0, serial], child, []))
                serial += 1
    return SearchResult([], answer, int(#answer), nodes, tests)

void join_visit(View first, View second, int a, int b, int[][] &answer, int &nodes, int &tests)
    nodes += 1
    left := first.nodes[a]
    right := second.nodes[b]
    if #left.children == 0 and #right.children == 0
        tests += int(#left.objects) * int(#right.objects)
        for point := left.objects[]
            for rectangle := right.objects[]
                if rtree.contains(object_box(rectangle), object_box(point))
                    answer = answer.append([rectangle[0], point[0]])
    elif #left.children == 0
        for child := right.children[]
            if rtree.intersects(left.box, second.nodes[child].box)
                join_visit(first, second, a, child, &answer, &nodes, &tests)
    elif #right.children == 0
        for child := left.children[]
            if rtree.intersects(first.nodes[child].box, right.box)
                join_visit(first, second, child, b, &answer, &nodes, &tests)
    else
        for u := left.children[]
            for v := right.children[]
                if rtree.intersects(first.nodes[u].box, second.nodes[v].box)
                    join_visit(first, second, u, v, &answer, &nodes, &tests)

SearchResult join_search(View first, View second)
    int[][] answer := []
    nodes := 0
    tests := 0
    join_visit(first, second, 0, 0, &answer, &nodes, &tests)
    return SearchResult([], ordered_join(answer), int(#answer), nodes, tests)
int[] object_ids(int[][] objects)
    return [for object := objects[] then object[0]]

string[] dump_tree(View view)
    string[] lines := []
    for index := preorder(view)[]
        node := view.nodes[index]
        text := ""
        if view.name == "kdtree"
            axis_name := if node.axis == 0 then "x" else "y"
            text = "{node.mark} {axis_name} {words(raw_point(node.objects[0]))} box {words(node.box)}"
        elif view.name == "quadtree"
            text = "{node.mark} {words(node.square)}"
            if #node.children > 0
                text += " node count {node.count}"
            else
                text += " leaf {report.ids(object_ids(node.objects))}"
        elif node.level == 0
            text = "leaf {words(node.box)} ids {report.ids(object_ids(node.objects))}"
        else
            text = "node {node.level} {words(node.box)} entries {node.entry_count}"
        lines = lines.append(" " * nat(2 * (node.depth + 1)) + text)
    return lines

string[] kd_statistics(View view)
    int[][] levels := []
    leaves := 0
    one_child := 0
    depth_sum := 0
    for node := view.nodes[]
        while int(#levels) <= node.depth
            levels = levels.append([0, 0, 0])
        levels[node.depth][0] += 1
        depth_sum += node.depth
        if #node.children == 0
            levels[node.depth][1] += 1
            leaves += 1
        elif #node.children == 1
            levels[node.depth][2] += 1
            one_child += 1
    ideal := 0
    capacity := 0
    while capacity < int(#view.nodes)
        ideal += 1
        capacity = capacity * 2 + 1
    lines := ["kdtree height {#levels} ideal {ideal} nodes {#view.nodes} leaves {leaves} one_child {one_child} depth_sum {depth_sum} avg_depth {report.fraction(depth_sum, int(#view.nodes))}"]
    for: depth < int(#levels)
        values := levels[depth]
        lines = lines.append("  depth {depth} nodes {values[0]} leaves {values[1]} one_child {values[2]}")
    return lines

string[] quad_statistics(View view, int bucket)
    int[][] levels := []
    internal := 0
    leaves := 0
    empty := 0
    largest := 0
    for node := view.nodes[]
        while int(#levels) <= node.depth
            levels = levels.append([0, 0, 0])
        if #node.children > 0
            levels[node.depth][0] += 1
            internal += 1
        else
            count := int(#node.objects)
            levels[node.depth][1] += 1
            levels[node.depth][2] += count
            leaves += 1
            if count == 0
                empty += 1
            if count > largest
                largest = count
    lines := ["quadtree height {#levels} internal {internal} leaves {leaves} empty {empty} max_leaf {largest} fill {report.fraction(view.nodes[0].count, leaves * bucket)}"]
    for: depth < int(#levels)
        values := levels[depth]
        lines = lines.append("  depth {depth} internal {values[0]} leaves {values[1]} points {values[2]}")
    return lines

string[] rtree_statistics(View view, int maximum, int minimum)
    height := view.nodes[0].level + 1
    int[][] levels := [for i := (0:<int(height))[] then []]
    leaves := 0
    entries := 0
    for: i < int(#view.nodes)
        node := view.nodes[i]
        levels[node.level] = levels[node.level].append(i)
        entries += node.entry_count
        if node.level == 0
            leaves += 1
    lines := ["{view.name} height {height} nodes {#view.nodes} leaves {leaves} entries {entries} fill {report.fraction(entries, int(#view.nodes) * maximum)}"]
    for: offset < height
        level := height - offset - 1
        indices := levels[level]
        sum := 0
        low := view.nodes[indices[0]].entry_count
        high := 0
        under := 0
        total_area := 0
        total_overlap := 0
        for: i < int(#indices)
            node := view.nodes[indices[i]]
            count := node.entry_count
            sum += count
            if count < low
                low = count
            if count > high
                high = count
            if count < minimum
                under += 1
            total_area += rtree.area(node.box)
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#indices)
                total_overlap += rtree.overlap(node.box, view.nodes[indices[j]].box)
        lines = lines.append("  level {level} nodes {#indices} entries {sum} min {low} max {high} under {under} area {total_area} overlap {total_overlap}")
    return lines

string[] grid_statistics(View view)
    counts := [for child := view.nodes[0].children[] then int(#view.nodes[child].objects)]
    largest := 0
    used := 0
    for count := counts[]
        if count > 0
            used += 1
        if count > largest
            largest = count
    occupancy := [for i := (0:<int(largest + 1))[] then 0]
    for count := counts[]
        occupancy[count] += 1
    string[] terms := []
    for: count < int(#occupancy)
        if occupancy[count] > 0
            terms = terms.append("{count}:{occupancy[count]}")
    return ["grid cells {#counts} used {used} max {largest}", "  occupancy {terms.join(" ")}"]

string rtree_position(rtree.Tree tree, int[] point)
    found := tree.find_leaf(point[0], object_box(point_object(point)))
    current := found.node
    path := ["{found.entry + 1}"]
    while tree.nodes[current].parent >= 0
        int parent := tree.nodes[current].parent
        for: i < int(#tree.nodes[parent].entries)
            if tree.nodes[parent].entries[i].child == current
                path = ["{i + 1}"].concat(path)
                break
        current = parent
    return path.join("/")

                    if rtree.contains(object_box(rectangle), object_box(point))
                        pairs = pairs.append([rectangle[0], point[0]])
            return Answer([], ordered_join(pairs), int(#pairs))
        objects := if command == 4 or command == 5 then data.rectangles else point_rows
        int[] ids := []
        int[][] distances := []
        for object := objects[]
            if command == 2 or command == 5
                distances = distances.append([object[0], minimum_distance(values, object_box(object))])
            elif object_condition(command, values, object)
                ids = ids.append(object[0])
        if command == 2 or command == 5
            selected := ordered_distances(distances)[0:<values[2]]
            return Answer([], selected, int(#selected))
        return Answer(ids.sorted(), [], int(#ids))

    void .record_visit(int number, int command, int structure, int nodes, int tests)
        names := structure_names()
        visits = visits.append("{number},{command_names()[command]},{names[structure]},{nodes},{tests}")
        totals[command][structure][0] += 1
        totals[command][structure][1] += nodes
        totals[command][structure][2] += tests
        if nodes > totals[command][structure][3]
            totals[command][structure][3] = nodes

    void .search(int number, int command, int[] values)
        View[] roots := self.views()
        Answer expected := self.brute(command, values)
        int[] indices := if command == 4 or command == 5 then [5, 6] elif command == 6 then [2, 3] else [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
        string[] mismatches := []
        for structure := indices[]
            actual := if command == 6 then join_search(roots[structure], roots[structure + 3]) elif command == 2 or command == 5 then nearest_search(roots[structure], values) else conditional_search(roots[structure], command, values)
            .self.record_visit(number, command, structure, actual.nodes, actual.tests)
            agrees := if command == 3 then actual.count == expected.count elif command == 2 or command == 5 or command == 6 then actual.pairs == expected.pairs else actual.ids == expected.ids
            if not agrees
                mismatches = mismatches.append(structure_names()[structure])
        check := if #mismatches == 0 then "ok" else "mismatch {mismatches.join(" ")}"
        line := "{number} {command_names()[command]} count {expected.count}"
        if command == 2 or command == 5
            line += " ids {report.distances(expected.pairs)}"
        elif command != 3 and command != 6
            line += " ids {report.ids(expected.ids)}"
        answers = answers.append("{line} check {check}")
        if command == 6
            for pair := expected.pairs[]
                joins = joins.append("{number},{pair[0]},{pair[1]}")

    void .snapshot(int query)
        View[] roots := self.views()
        if #structures > 0
            structures = structures.append("")
            statistics = statistics.append("")
        header := "snapshot {snapshot_count} query {query} points {point_count} rects {#data.rectangles}"
        structures = structures.append(header)
        statistics = statistics.append(header)
        for structure := [0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6][]
            structures = structures.append(structure_names()[structure]).concat(dump_tree(roots[structure]))
        statistics = statistics.concat(kd_statistics(roots[0])).concat(quad_statistics(roots[1], bucket))
        for structure := [2, 3, 5, 6][]
            statistics = statistics.concat(rtree_statistics(roots[structure], maximum, minimum))
        statistics = statistics.concat(grid_statistics(roots[4]))

    string locate(int number, int id)
        match points.get(id)
            none
                return "{number} LOCATE {id} missing"
            int[] object
                point := raw_point(object)
                current := kd_tree.root
                kd_path := ""
                while kd_tree.nodes[current].point[0] != id
                    kdtree.Node node := kd_tree.nodes[current]
                    if kdtree.less(point, node.point, node.axis)
                        kd_path += "L"
                        current = node.left
                    else
                        kd_path += "R"
                        current = node.right
                string[] quad_path := []
                quadrant_names := ["NW", "NE", "SW", "SE"]
                current = 0
                while #quad_tree.nodes[current].children > 0
                    child := quad_tree.destination(current, point)
                    quad_path = quad_path.append(quadrant_names[child])
                    current = quad_tree.nodes[current].children[child]
                position := cell_grid.position(point)
                kd_text := if #kd_path == 0 then "-" else kd_path
                quad_text := if #quad_path == 0 then "-" else quad_path.join("/")
                return "{number} LOCATE {id} kdtree {kd_text} quadtree {quad_text} rtree {rtree_position(point_tree, point)} str {rtree_position(bulk_tree, point)} grid {position[0]} {position[1]}"

    void .insert(int[] point)
        .kd_tree.insert(point)
        .quad_tree.insert(point)
        .point_tree.insert_entry(rtree.Entry(object_box(point_object(point)), point[0], -1))
        .bulk_tree.insert_entry(rtree.Entry(object_box(point_object(point)), point[0], -1))
        .cell_grid.insert(point)
        .points.set(point[0], point_object(point))
        point_count += 1

    bool .delete(int id)
        match points.get(id)
            none
                return false
            int[] object
                point := raw_point(object)
                .kd_tree.delete(point)
                .quad_tree.delete(point)
                .point_tree.delete(point)
                .bulk_tree.delete(point)
                .cell_grid.delete(point)
                .points.remove(id)
                point_count -= 1
                return true

    void .handle_command(int number, dataset.Command command)
        name := command.name
        values := command.values
        if name == "LOCATE"
            answers = answers.append(self.locate(number, values[0]))
        elif name == "INSERT"
            .self.insert(values)
            answers = answers.append("{number} INSERT {values[0]} inserted points {point_count}")
        elif name == "DELETE"
            bool removed := .self.delete(values[0])
            status := if removed then "deleted" else "missing"
            answers = answers.append("{number} DELETE {values[0]} {status} points {point_count}")
        elif name == "DUMP"
            snapshot_count += 1
            .self.snapshot(number)
            answers = answers.append("{number} DUMP snapshot {snapshot_count}")
        else
            .self.search(number, index_name(command_names(), name), values)

    void .finish()
        statistics = statistics.append("").append("visits")
        for: command < 7
            int[] indices := []
            for: structure < 7
                total := totals[command][structure]
                if total[0] > 0
                    indices = indices.append(structure)
                    statistics = statistics.append("{command_names()[command]} {structure_names()[structure]} queries {total[0]} nodes {total[1]} tests {total[2]} max_nodes {total[3]} mean_nodes {report.fraction(total[1], total[0])}")
            if #indices == 0
                continue
            int[] ranked := []
            for structure := indices[]
                position := 0
                key := [totals[command][structure][1], totals[command][structure][2], structure]
                while position < int(#ranked)
                    other := ranked[position]
                    if rtree.less(key, [totals[command][other][1], totals[command][other][2], other])
                        break
                    position += 1
                ranked = ranked[0:<position].append(structure).concat(ranked[position:<int(#ranked)])
            names := [for structure := ranked[] then structure_names()[structure]]
            statistics = statistics.append("rank {command_names()[command]} {names.join(" ")}")
        report.write_lines("answers.txt", answers)
        report.write_lines("visits.csv", visits)
        report.write_lines("join.csv", joins)
        report.write_lines("structures.txt", structures)
        report.write_lines("stats.txt", statistics)

void run()
    data := dataset.read_inputs()
    lab := Lab(data)
    .lab.snapshot(0)
    for: i < int(#data.commands)
        .lab.handle_command(i + 1, data.commands[i])
    .lab.finish()

run()

int[][] insert_sorted(int[][] points, int[] point)
    place := int(#points)
    for: i < int(#points)
        if point[0] < points[i][0]
            place = i
            break
    return points[0:<place].append(point).concat(points[place:<int(#points)])

class Node(int x, int y, int size, int[][] points, int[] children)

class Tree self(Node[] nodes, int capacity)
    int destination(int index, int[] point)
        half := nodes[index].size / 2
        east := if point[1] >= nodes[index].x + half then 1 else 0
        south := if point[2] >= nodes[index].y + half then 2 else 0
        return east + south

    void .insert(int[] point)
        current := 0
        while #nodes[current].children > 0
            current = nodes[current].children[destination(current, point)]
        nodes[current].points = insert_sorted(nodes[current].points, point)
        pending := [current]
        while #pending != 0
            index := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
            if int(#nodes[index].points) <= capacity
                continue
            x := nodes[index].x
            y := nodes[index].y
            half := nodes[index].size / 2
            previous := nodes[index].points
            first := int(#nodes)
            nodes = nodes.append(Node(x, y, half, [], []))
            nodes = nodes.append(Node(x + half, y, half, [], []))
            nodes = nodes.append(Node(x, y + half, half, [], []))
            nodes = nodes.append(Node(x + half, y + half, half, [], []))
            nodes[index].children = [first, first + 1, first + 2, first + 3]
            nodes[index].points = []
            for value := previous[]
                child := first + destination(index, value)
                nodes[child].points = nodes[child].points.append(value)
            for: reverse < 4
                child := first + 3 - reverse
                if int(#nodes[child].points) > capacity
                    pending = pending.append(child)

    void .delete(int[] point)
        current := 0
        int[] ancestors := []
        while #nodes[current].children > 0
            ancestors = ancestors.append(current)
            current = nodes[current].children[destination(current, point)]
        nodes[current].points = [for value := nodes[current].points[] if value[0] != point[0] then value]
        for: reverse < int(#ancestors)
            index := ancestors[int(#ancestors) - reverse - 1]
            merge := true
            count := 0
            for child := nodes[index].children[]
                if #nodes[child].children > 0
                    merge = false
                    break
                count += int(#nodes[child].points)
            if not merge or count > capacity
                break
            int[][] points := []
            for child := nodes[index].children[]
                for value := nodes[child].points[]
                    points = insert_sorted(points, value)
            nodes[index].points = points
            nodes[index].children = []

Tree build(int[][] points, int world, int capacity)
    result := Tree([Node(0, 0, world, [], [])], capacity)
    for point := points[]
        .result.insert(point)
    return result

string fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    first := numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return "{numerator / first}/{denominator / first}"

string ids(int[] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value}"]
    return if #fields == 0 then "-" else fields.join(" ")

string distances(int[][] values)
    fields := [for value := values[] then "{value[0]}:{value[1]}"]
    return if #fields == 0 then "-" else fields.join(" ")

void write_lines(string name, string[] rows)
    content := if #rows == 0 then "" else rows.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(content)

int area(int[] box)
    return (box[2] - box[0]) * (box[3] - box[1])

int[] mbr(int[] first, int[] second)
    return [
        if first[0] < second[0] then first[0] else second[0],
        if first[1] < second[1] then first[1] else second[1],
        if first[2] > second[2] then first[2] else second[2],
        if first[3] > second[3] then first[3] else second[3],
    ]

int enlargement(int[] first, int[] second)
    return area(mbr(first, second)) - area(first)

bool contains(int[] outer, int[] inner)
    return outer[0] <= inner[0] and inner[2] <= outer[2] and outer[1] <= inner[1] and inner[3] <= outer[3]

bool intersects(int[] first, int[] second)
    return first[0] <= second[2] and second[0] <= first[2] and first[1] <= second[3] and second[1] <= first[3]

int overlap(int[] first, int[] second)
    right := if first[2] < second[2] then first[2] else second[2]
    left := if first[0] > second[0] then first[0] else second[0]
    top := if first[1] > second[1] then first[1] else second[1]
    bottom := if first[3] < second[3] then first[3] else second[3]
    width := right - left
    height := bottom - top
    return if width > 0 and height > 0 then width * height else 0

bool less(int[] first, int[] second)
    for: i < int(#first)
        if first[i] != second[i]
            return first[i] < second[i]
    return false

int smaller(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

class Entry(int[] box, int id, int child)
class Node(int level, Entry[] entries, int parent)
class Found(int node, int entry)

int[] sorted_entries(Entry[] entries, int[] numbers, int axis, int[] indices)
    int[] result := []
    for index := indices[]
        box := entries[index].box
        key := [box[axis] + box[axis + 2], box[1 - axis] + box[3 - axis], numbers[index]]
        place := int(#result)
        for: k < int(#result)
            other := result[k]
            other_box := entries[other].box
            other_key := [other_box[axis] + other_box[axis + 2], other_box[1 - axis] + other_box[3 - axis], numbers[other]]
            if less(key, other_key)
                place = k
                break
        result = result[0:<place].append(index).concat(result[place:<int(#result)])
    return result

class Tree self(Node[] nodes, int root, int maximum, int minimum)
    int[] node_box(int index)
        entries := nodes[index].entries
        result := entries[0].box
        for: 1 <= i < int(#entries)
            result = mbr(result, entries[i].box)
        return result

    int .new_node(int level, Entry[] entries, parent := -1)
        index := int(#nodes)
        nodes = nodes.append(Node(level, entries, parent))
        if level > 0
            for entry := entries[]
                nodes[entry.child].parent = index
        return index

    void .assign_entries(int index, Entry[] entries)
        nodes[index].entries = entries
        if nodes[index].level > 0
            for entry := entries[]
                nodes[entry.child].parent = index

    int choose_subtree(int[] box, int level)
        current := root
        while nodes[current].level > level
            entries := nodes[current].entries
            selected := 0
            for: 1 <= i < int(#entries)
                first := entries[i].box
                second := entries[selected].box
                if less([enlargement(first, box), area(first)], [enlargement(second, box), area(second)])
                    selected = i
            current = entries[selected].child
        return current

    int .split(int current)
        entries := nodes[current].entries
        first_seed := 0
        second_seed := 1
        best := area(mbr(entries[0].box, entries[1].box)) - area(entries[0].box) - area(entries[1].box)
        for: i < int(#entries) - 1
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#entries)
                waste := area(mbr(entries[i].box, entries[j].box)) - area(entries[i].box) - area(entries[j].box)
                if waste > best
                    first_seed = i
                    second_seed = j
                    best = waste
        first := [entries[first_seed]]
        second := [entries[second_seed]]
        Entry[] rest := []
        for: i < int(#entries)
            if i != first_seed and i != second_seed
                rest = rest.append(entries[i])
        box1 := entries[first_seed].box
        box2 := entries[second_seed].box
        while #rest != 0
            if int(#first) + int(#rest) == minimum
                first = first.concat(rest)
                break
            if int(#second) + int(#rest) == minimum
                second = second.concat(rest)
                break
            selected := 0
            greatest := -1
            selected_d1 := 0
            selected_d2 := 0
            for: i < int(#rest)
                d1 := enlargement(box1, rest[i].box)
                d2 := enlargement(box2, rest[i].box)
                difference := if d1 >= d2 then d1 - d2 else d2 - d1
                if difference > greatest
                    selected = i
                    greatest = difference
                    selected_d1 = d1
                    selected_d2 = d2
            entry := rest[selected]
            rest = rest[0:<selected].concat(rest[selected + 1:<int(#rest)])
            if less([selected_d1, area(box1), int(#first), 0], [selected_d2, area(box2), int(#second), 1])
                first = first.append(entry)
                box1 = mbr(box1, entry.box)
            else
                second = second.append(entry)
                box2 = mbr(box2, entry.box)
        .self.assign_entries(current, first)
        return .self.new_node(nodes[current].level, second, nodes[current].parent)

    void .insert_entry(Entry entry, level := 0)
        current := choose_subtree(entry.box, level)
        nodes[current].entries = nodes[current].entries.append(entry)
        if level > 0
            nodes[entry.child].parent = current
        while true
            sibling := -1
            if int(#nodes[current].entries) > maximum
                sibling = .self.split(current)
            parent := nodes[current].parent
            if parent < 0
                if sibling >= 0
                    entries := [Entry(node_box(current), 0, current), Entry(node_box(sibling), 0, sibling)]
                    root = .self.new_node(nodes[current].level + 1, entries)
                return
            for: i < int(#nodes[parent].entries)
                if nodes[parent].entries[i].child == current
                    nodes[parent].entries[i].box = node_box(current)
                    break
            if sibling >= 0
                nodes[parent].entries = nodes[parent].entries.append(Entry(node_box(sibling), 0, sibling))
                nodes[sibling].parent = parent
            current = parent

    Found find_leaf(int id, int[] box)
        pending := [root]
        while #pending != 0
            current := pending[-1]
            pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
            entries := nodes[current].entries
            if nodes[current].level == 0
                for: i < int(#entries)
                    if entries[i].id == id
                        return Found(current, i)
            else
                for: reverse < int(#entries)
                    entry := entries[int(#entries) - reverse - 1]
                    if contains(entry.box, box)
                        pending = pending.append(entry.child)
        return Found(-1, -1)

    void .delete(int[] point)
        box := [point[1], point[2], point[1], point[2]]
        found := find_leaf(point[0], box)
        current := found.node
        position := found.entry
        entries := nodes[current].entries
        nodes[current].entries = entries[0:<position].concat(entries[position + 1:<int(#entries)])
        int[] removed := []
        while current != root
            parent := nodes[current].parent
            for: i < int(#nodes[parent].entries)
                if nodes[parent].entries[i].child == current
                    if int(#nodes[current].entries) < minimum
                        parent_entries := nodes[parent].entries
                        nodes[parent].entries = parent_entries[0:<i].concat(parent_entries[i + 1:<int(#parent_entries)])
                        removed = removed.append(current)
                        nodes[current].parent = -1
                    else
                        nodes[parent].entries[i].box = node_box(current)
                    break
            current = parent
        for discarded := removed[]
            reinsertion := nodes[discarded].entries
            level := nodes[discarded].level
            for entry := reinsertion[]
                .self.insert_entry(entry, level)
        while nodes[root].level > 0 and #nodes[root].entries == 1
            root = nodes[root].entries[0].child
            nodes[root].parent = -1

    void .bulk_load(Entry[] entries)
        numbers := [for entry := entries[] then entry.id]
        level := 0
        while true
            count := int(#entries)
            pages := (count + maximum - 1) / maximum
            slabs := 1
            while slabs * slabs < pages
                slabs += 1
            ordered := sorted_entries(entries, numbers, 0, 0:<count)
            slab_size := slabs * maximum
            int[] created := []
            for: start < count step slab_size
                slab := ordered[start:<smaller(count, start + slab_size)]
                slab = sorted_entries(entries, numbers, 1, slab)
                for: offset < int(#slab) step maximum
                    indices := slab[offset:<smaller(int(#slab), offset + maximum)]
                    group := [for i := indices[] then entries[i]]
                    created = created.append(.self.new_node(level, group))
            if #created == 1
                root = created[0]
                nodes[root].parent = -1
                return
            entries = []
            numbers = []
            for: i < int(#created)
                entries = entries.append(Entry(node_box(created[i]), 0, created[i]))
                numbers = numbers.append(i)
            level += 1

Tree build(int[][] objects, int maximum, int minimum, bool bulk)
    result := Tree([], -1, maximum, minimum)
    result.root = .result.new_node(0, [])
    entries := [for object := objects[] then Entry(object[1:<5], object[0], -1)]
    if bulk
        .result.bulk_load(entries)
    else
        for entry := entries[]
            .result.insert_entry(entry)
    return result
